transfer_taxes.name: DC deed recordation tax
transfer_taxes.source_title: DC OTR: Recorder of Deeds / recordation & transfer tax rates
transfer_taxes.notes: Residential: 1.1% if under $400,000; 1.45% on the ENTIRE amount at $400,000+. Customarily buyer (OTR rate page does not name payer; ROD-11 says first-time-buyer recordation benefit goes entirely to grantee). First-time DC homebuyers meeting income/price limits: recordation rate 0.725% (https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/sites/default/files/dc/sites/otr/publication/attachments/ROD%2011%20-%20Reduced%20Recordation%20Tax%20Rate%20for%20First-Time%20Homebuyers%20FY2026.pdf).

transfer_taxes.name: DC deed transfer tax
transfer_taxes.source_title: DC OTR: Recorder of Deeds / recordation & transfer tax rates
transfer_taxes.notes: Same rates as recordation tax. ROD-11: 'the full amount of the transfer tax ... should be allocated to the transferor' (seller). No separate recordation tax on purchase-money deed of trust found on fetched page (only $150 recording fee).
